summary: cloudflare_module postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The npm package cloudflare_module@3.0.0 ships a postinstall script (`node beacon.cjs`) and a main entry (`index.js`) that both invoke a beacon on install and on require. beacon.cjs POSTs installer-side identifiers — hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node version — to the hardcoded cleartext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The package exports a Proxy that silently returns no-op values for any property access, so it has no functional purpose beyond the callback and will not crash a build that imports it. The package name resembles the Cloudflare ecosystem; a source comment frames a completing install that calls back as 'cleaner evidence,' consistent with a dependency-confusion payload rather than legitimate telemetry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
